data.why: The app ships its own catalog (sweetercat/data/sweet-cat.tsv, sweetercat/data/exoplanetEU.csv) which readSC()/planetAndStar() load directly; no upload step exists in this interface.

goals: Browse the full SWEET-Cat table of stellar parameters sorted by most recently updated measurement
Open a star's detail page to read its atmospheric parameters, derived luminosity, and habitable-zone limits
Compare two stellar parameters against each other (e.g. Teff vs logg, mass vs [Fe/H]) on /plot/, optionally color-coded by a third parameter
Compare a stellar and a planetary parameter together (e.g. planet mass vs discovery year or vs orbital period) on /plot-exo/
Use linked-brushing across multiple parameter panels on /linked/ to spot correlated outliers
Download the curated catalog as CSV or HDF for offline analysis

review.summary: The tree describes SWEETer-Cat well as a catalogue browser plus parameter-plotting front end. The phases follow real stages, the labels are clean at both levels, and the cited screens and an independent replay mostly confirm every task. It needs a few citation fixes (tooltip, default sort, downloads), a per-star record-page feature, and an explicit note that the habitable-zone plot and linked brushing failed in this install before it is filed.
